description: This file defines a Java interface `CredentialsClientFactory` that provides factory methods for creating and retrieving credentials clients for Hono's Credentials API, including static creation methods, connection handling, and tenant-specific client retrieval.

classes.name: CredentialsClientFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating and retrieving credentials clients for Hono's Credentials API, supporting connection management and tenant-specific client retrieval.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a factory for an existing connection without caching.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a factory for an existing connection with an optional cache provider for credential objects.

methods.name: getOrCreateCredentialsClient
methods.description: Returns a Future that will complete with a credentials client for the specified tenant, creating it if necessary.
